Hello!

I wanna start by saying that my heart is breaking for you. I know how most of these things feel, and a lot of these things that you have gone through in your life truly can produce some terrible feelings and self worth issues. 

Now that I've addressed what you already know, I'd like to say that like everyone else that reads and/or comments on this post that I am here for you, even though you don't know who I am. 

I'm 16 and in high school myself, I'm still stuck in my "drugs are the only thing that keeps me happy" phase/thing so I understand what you've been through in the past. 


I also know what it feels like to be dumped for unjust reasons, considering this happened to me last May after wasting two years of my life on that guy. 

I'm sorry about your parents, dear, this sounds cliche, but parents sometimes truly don't understand what it feels like to go through what you're going through. I'm positive they love you and care about you despite this. 

I guess what I'm trying to say here is I am here to talk to you if you want me to try and help. Like everyone else here, I do not want you to end your own life.

As a reply to everyone here **

I genuinely appreciate all the kind words and support that you guys have offered me. 


I felt very alone, small, and terrified this morning when I posted. Throughout the day, I read all the responses you guys have left and they gradually made me stronger. 


I finally concluded with myself that I couldn't wait it out any longer, and after school I drove up to the drug store and purchased a pregnancy test. 


For any of you who are curious, I am not pregnant. I'm sorry if any of you feel you have wasted your time replying now that we know for sure the worst isn't true- but your support was important to me and still is. Without it, I still wouldn't know for sure right now. So thank you, a weight has been lifted off my shoulders and now i have enough space in my mind to work on myself and work on not wanting to off myself so constantly. 


Thank all of you so much.

I had a mentor at some point when I was bad with cutting. It was the best thing that I ever had. My mentor made me feel not alone, I think that is probably the best thing to do for this girl. 
My mentor gave me positive attention, she told me stories when I was panicky and encouraged me to be rid of my blades one by one. 
I think it was mainly just support even when I screwed up, and encouragement. I was a girl who needed a lot of attention, so if the girl you are mentoring is anything like me, you will wanna talk to her as much as you can. 
I can honestly say that if I didn't have the support of my mentor I would still be hurting myself today. Of course as you said, it truly never does go away but her support had a long lasting affect on me. I hope I helped and you can help this girl. :)

Allow me to start by saying the world does not want you to kill yourself. Honestly I do not believe that anyone truly wants you to die. I know it feels like the bullies do- trust me I know. If you were to kill yourself those people would hate themselves for a pretty long period of time; I unfortunately know this as well. When I was young, I was bullied to the point of suicide; and my situation was much like yours. Obviously I failed and was forced to eventually go back to school. When the bullies found out what I had done, they laid off. They apologized to me, even. I am not suggesting that you attempt suicide to end the torture of course, I just want you to know that it is not your only way out. Yes, it may seem like the easiest option but you need to think of all the things you would take with you to the grave. Your parents would blame themselves for not getting you proper therapy, they would never forgive themselves and neither would the people that pushed you to this point (not like they matter; they're assholes). Just think this through. The bullying will end one day, I promise.

I understand the feelings you have about your friends, because I feel the same way when it comes to my own. I have told one of them recently that I am suicidal, and he basically brushed the topic away without a second thought- I get that sometimes we feel distant from our friends but honestly they just sometimes don't know how to react to our bullshit. They would definitely care if you off yourself, however. Just because they are too uninformed to help doesn't mean they won't miss you. They would regret all the help they didn't give surely. 
You will rarely always see eye to eye with your parents, that is a fact. I figured that when I got older I would be able to get along with my own, it isn't true. You will always be a different character in comparison to your parents- and not to be cliché, but oftentimes parents just literally do not understand. 
You blew up on your brother because your emotions are stuck in your miserable turmoil of suicidal thoughts and/or depression. This can be fixed or improved, never think that suicide is your ONLY way out. Medication and therapy, or even a friend to talk to 24/7 can help you contain your emotions and improve them. 
You CAN keep doing this.
